description: This file defines the class SiloAdoNetStreamConfigurator, which helps set up and configure an AdoNet-based stream provider within an Orleans silo. It includes methods to configure AdoNet options, caching, and partitioning.

classes.name: SiloAdoNetStreamConfigurator
classes.description: A configurator class for setting up AdoNet stream providers in an Orleans silo environment.

methods.description: Constructor that initializes configuration with name and setup delegate.

methods.name: ConfigureAdoNet
methods.description: Allows external configuration of AdoNet options.

methods.name: ConfigureCache
methods.description: Configures cache size for the stream provider.

methods.name: ConfigurePartitioning
methods.description: Configures the number of partitions for the stream provider.
